title: Seminaire de Geometrie Algebrique (SGA): English Translation Working Drafts
version: 2026-05-29 SGA cumulative refresh: SGA 4 clean cumulative, SGA 5 available segments, SGA 6 current cumulative, SGA 7-I through Expose IX section 6.6
description:
Linked SGA record for the Modern LaTeX Editions of Public-Domain Mathematics Manuscripts project. This record collects current English translation working drafts, source/reference PDFs, and render checks for continuing SGA translation work. The public surface is organized around coherent cumulative reader PDFs, with source TeX, render checks, prior segment packets, logs, and validation material kept in ZIP artifacts.

Human-readable contents. This release contains existing English translation snapshots for SGA 1, SGA 2, and SGA 3; a clean cumulative English working reader for SGA 4; current cumulative English working readers for available SGA 5 and SGA 6 translation material; a current cumulative SGA 7-I reader through Expose IX section 6.6; and the new non-overlapping 50-page SGA 7-I continuation as a separate checking PDF. French reference PDFs for SGA 1 through SGA 7 are included as top-level checking files where locally available.

  • SGA 6 English working material: [#######---] current cumulative reader present; current clean cumulative reader is 231 pages and remains a working draft pending source audit.
  • SGA 7-I English working material: [##--------] current cumulative reader present; current clean cumulative reader is 106 pages, with a separate 50-page continuation through Expose IX section 6.6.
  • Original/reference PDFs for SGA 1-7: [##########] present where locally available, as direct top-level files for checking against the translations.

Workflow. Source scans, existing translation snapshots, TeX drafts, render checks, and reference PDFs are organized here for inspection and continuation. Reader-facing files use corpus/volume/expose titles; source material and editorial work files are kept in artifact ZIPs rather than in public titles or reader PDFs.
notes: Current public-facing SGA record, organized by cumulative reader PDFs, reference scans, and source artifacts. SGA 5 is explicitly a current available-segments reader, not a certified complete SGA 5 volume.
